items.title: Nextdc Investor UniSuper Says ‘Not That Keen’ on Data Centers
items.summary: One of Australia’s top pension funds is steering clear of direct investments in data centers, arguing the biggest winners from the artificial intelligence boom will ultimately be the companies that harness the technology rather than those building the infrastructure behind it.
